uslaw-usc-t2-s179v:
Section 179v of Title 2 authorizes appropriations to the Librarian of Congress for a set of film preservation sections. Money is authorized for the first fiscal year beginning on or after October 11, 1996. It is authorized for each succeeding fiscal year through fiscal year 2026. The sums are those necessary to carry out the purposes of the sections named in the text.

A hard ceiling tempers the open authorization. In no fiscal year may the sum exceed two hundred and fifty thousand dollars. The section sits in Chapter 5 of Title 2, on the Library of Congress. It closes the range of sections it funds, which run from section 179l to section 179w of the title. The hosted Code text is published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel, current through Public Law 119-134. Authorization here is a permit with a cap, not a blank cheque.
